date: # Rides per quarter where the operator reports quarterly (date = quarter start). Baidu counts fully driverless rides from Q2 2025; before that its figure is all Apollo Go rides (over 70% driverless in Q3 2024).

note: Q3 2024 results: 988K rides (all rides; fully driverless over 70%)
Q4 2024 results: over 1.1 million rides (all rides)
Q1 2025 results: over 1.4 million rides; fully driverless across China since Feb 2025
Q2 2025 results: more than 2.2 million fully driverless rides
Q3 2025 results: 3.1 million fully driverless operational rides
Q4 2025 results: 3.4 million fully driverless operational rides
Q1 2026 results: approximately 3.2 million fully driverless operational rides

Q2 2026 earnings call, 18 Aug 2026 (Motley Fool transcript): CEO Robin Li's prepared remarks say "around 1 million fully driverless operational rides in Q2", volume hit by regulatory-related adjustments in some cities; the press release gives kilometres only, and the interim report (H1 over 4.1m less Q1 3.2m) implies about 0.9m
